QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Restoring the Altar
QuestInfo.0: The #bBattle Statue#k told you you about the #rchaos#k in Masteria.
QuestInfo.1: You learned about the importance of the Crimsonwood Altar and the Twisted Masters. Enter the #rCrimsonwood Altar Party Quest#k to defeat the masters, then report back to Ridley in #bCrimsonwood Keep#k.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the #bhero's weapon#k to the altar after defeating the #rmasters#k. Is Masteria #rstable#k now?

0.0: The #baltar#k in Masteria is more #rimportant#k than you'd think. It is the sword and shield that protects us, and we must keep it sharpened.
0.1: When the #blegendary weapons#k fell into the hands of the #rTwisted Masters#k, our people could no longer bear arms. The continent fell into chaos. We must return the weapons to the #baltar#k to win the fight.
0.2: The masters are evil incarnations of our greatest warriors, twisted by the world of Versal and seduced by the evils of Naricain. They will #babsorb the souls of the weapons#k, and bring Naricain back to our lands.
0.3: They have shielded themselves with #rbarriers#k to finish their absorption, like soldiers fleeing from the fray.
0.4: The barrier that once kept your people at bay has been taken down, and the #rTwisted Masters#k now focus their energy on their own personal safety. A chink has appeared in their armor!
0.5: This is the time for your traveling warriors to sweep in for a surprise attack. If they completely absorb those weapons, irreversible destruction will sweep across Masteria. Enter the #rCrimsonwood Altar#k and vanquish the masters!

yes.0: Masteria's battle is in your hand. Report to #bRidley#k once you defeat the masters.

no.0: You're running from a fair fight?!

1.0: Did you find out any more about what's going on?\r\n#L0##b(You tell him about the Twisted Masters and the legendary weapons.)#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, the #baltar#k! It kept #bstability in Masteria#k in my age, before Naricain came and wrecked it all. That just might work!

yes.0: You think Masteria will be peaceful again, now that the weapons are back? I fear we've only begun to see the fruit of Naricain's evil schemes. There seems to be a strange #rnew barrier#k across our path to the Phantom Forest. It doesn't bode well for Crimsonwood, or the rest of Masteria...
yes.1: Either way, you did good. Peace will come to this continent eventually. Maybe on the day the #rnew barrier#k disappears, we'll need #byour help#k once again!

npc.0: Masteria is fighting a losing battle. Enter the #rCrimsonwood Altar#k, vanquish the masters, and let #bRidley#k know what happened.

quest.0: Did you find anything else about the #rmasters#k in the #m930100000#?
